scenario_description:
Objective: Improve Sunday's pantry reset by making neat printed container labels possible at no purchase cost.
Emerging Need: A community-lending offer moves from possible to confirmed only after the useful model, contact route, and cutoff become observable.
Decision Context: Stored household notes identify compatible tape already on hand; calendar, contact, email, and roommate updates establish the reset timing, borrowing route, model availability, and no-buy preference.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance simply leaves ordinary sticky-note labeling, while after the borrowing cutoff the optional polish cannot be added for this reset.

parameter.title: Pantry shelf reset
parameter.description: Clear dry goods, wipe shelves, and relabel containers only if supplies are easy to use.

parameter.subject: Weekend small-tools lending shelf
parameter.body: Today's lending shelf may include craft and home-organization tools. The final available list posts after noon; staff cannot hold any item before that list is published.

parameter.content: For tomorrow's pantry reset, I found the clear bins but not the old labeler. If labels aren't easy, sticky notes are fine; please don't buy a gadget for this.

parameter.name: Neighborhood Tool Library Borrowing Desk
parameter.notes: Handles same-day email holds for lending-shelf tools after availability posts.

parameter.subject: Available today: organization tools
parameter.body: Today's final lending-shelf list includes one Brother P-touch PT-D210 label maker. Same-day email holds are accepted until 16:00 for member pickup between 17:00 and 17:45 today; unclaimed items return to the shelf.

parameter.subject: Label maker hold window closed
parameter.body: The 16:00 hold cutoff has passed. Remaining lending-shelf tools today can only be borrowed by walk-in visitors who were already checked in before 16:00.
